title: Belief file mock proves register resolve furnish
description: Build the file-backed Belief Nexus proof of concept from the landed v1 vision. Sources are typed module files under a declared directory boundary; generation writes a workspace bundle and skills without damaging an existing workspace on malformed input or refusal.
design: Implement typed Register, Resolve, and Furnish through the translator and daemon boundaries. Derive placement from the source-folder Kind: Spirit and Intent modules enter the system-prompt bundle; every other Kind enters the skills directory. Preserve source/path ownership, use atomic candidate validation before generation, and emit typed refusal on malformed input. Defer repository watch, refurnish, and perma refresh explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: CLI proves Register, Resolve, and Furnish; malformed source content produces a typed refusal; an invalid candidate leaves the prior generated workspace intact; generated output contains the expected Codex bundle marker and skill consumption path according to source-folder Kind; source and output paths stay within owned boundaries; watch/refurnish/perma refresh are documented as deferred.
notes: Supersedes the earlier placement:SystemPrompt|Skill proposal: placement is derived from source-folder Kind. Spirit and Intent go to the system-prompt bundle; all other Kinds go to skills.
